text:
anna: Heads-up — customer on prod reported latency spikes that line up with retry bursts. They see 20–40s tail latency occasionally after 429/503, but request rate is steady. file attached to ticket.
sahil: Can you paste a minimal log snippet and SDK version? Also whether they use Session/connection pool reuse in workers.
anna: SDK v0.12.3. Log excerpt below — you can see the retry loop sleeping then long delay after a subsequent request:

    INFO api_client.py:send_request starting request id=cbf1
    WARN backoff.py:retry sleeping=0.48s attempt=1 for status=429
    INFO backoff.py:retry sleeping=0.92s attempt=2 for status=429
    INFO api_client.py:send_request request returned 200 id=cbf2
    INFO http.pool Reusing connection to api.redwood:443
    INFO api_client.py:send_request starting request id=cbf3
    ERROR timeout after 35s id=cbf3

anna: They say the spikes only happen after a sustained small spike of 429s, then subsequent unrelated requests land a huge delay.
mike: Sounds like the per-session jitter RNG gets reseeded or the backoff state is shared incorrectly when the HTTP connection is reused. We had a similar pattern in another library where connection pool reuse plus global backoff state caused correlated sleeps.
irene: Do they create one client per process or re-use the same Client() across threads with requests.Session? Reuse is common in uvicorn/workers setups.
anna: Reuse. Minimal repro I extracted from customer (runs inside gunicorn worker):

    from redwood import Client
    client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))  # reused across requests

    def handler(req):
        # many requests in quick succession
        r = client.generate(...)

    # gunicorn with multiple workers

anna: Quick local repro: spin up 2 threads, force some 429s from a mock server, then stop returning 429s — next normal requests occasionally hang for tens of seconds.
sahil: Can you try with v0.13.1? We shipped a fix that adjusted per-request RNG and isolated retry-state per call. If repro still happens, need trace logs with BACKOFF_DEBUG=1.
mike: Adding to that — include HTTP_POOL_DEBUG and capture Connection: reuse logs. Also include the idempotency-key header value; if header is mutated or regenerated inconsistently that could cause the SDK to await a match when the gateway is deduping.
anna: Will ask customer to test v0.13.1 and send BACKOFF_DEBUG logs. Also sending them a small patch they can monkeypatch to force non-shared RNG as a quick test.
infra-bot: Deploy triggered: redwood/api-client v0.13.1 -> canary (by @mike) :rocket:
sahil: If customer cannot upgrade immediately, workaround is to instantiate a new Client() per worker process or disable connection reuse (requests.Session=False) until we confirm. Not ideal but reduces correlated sleeps.
anna: Copying customer support note into ticket. Will follow up with logs and whether upgrade resolves.
mike: If we confirm repro, I'll open a bug with a reduced unit test and try to get a hotfix out. :eyes:
irene: Thanks — good triage. Keep the ticket ID on the thread.
